_note: Bought bikes (beenster's own 3D models, Nov 25). Their drawings are never in git: Tools/bought_bikes.py copies each one, scrambled, into Data/BikesV2/<model>.tsb before every PC build, so it ships inside the packaged game (friends get the real bike). 'source' is the game glb made from the bought .blend by BikesV2/foundry/bought_multistrada.py (the Multistrada) or bought_export.py (the rest). No sha256: the PC makes each glb with its own Blender, so the bytes differ from a cloud export; 'triangles' is what the export should report.
